messages:
anya: quick follow-up to the precision-profiles RFC — we need a short migration/safety checklist before enabling fp8/int8/4bit at scale. who wants to take ownership of the checklist?

sam: i'll own the QA/metrics side. key things i care about: calibration sample size, drift detection signals, and cheap shadow comparisons. :+1:

liam: my ops concerns: routing fallbacks and per-request latency spikes. prefer staged canary by model-family + region. also we should cap burst concurrency for quantized lanes.

maria: rough config template we can use for canaries (will expand in PR):
```json
{
  "model": "gptx-3b",
  "quant_profile": "fp8-lite",
  "calibration_samples": 1500,
  "quality_check": { "metric": "embedding_cosine", "threshold": 0.92 },
  "fallback": "int8",
  "canary_pct": 1
}
```

nora: infra notes: need per-shard telemetry for prefix/cache hit rates + breakdown by quant lane. also add a runtime flag to force-disable quantized kernels for debugging. @devops-bot can you add a quick alert if quant fallback rate > 5% for 5m?

devops-bot: alert rule created: `quant_fallback_rate > 5% for 5m` -> paging-ml, slack #eng-oncall.

liam: on the quality checks: for chat/generation we can't rely on BLEU. use embedding similarity + n-gram novelty heuristics. also enforce a max perplexity shift if we can compute it cheaply.

sam: agree. propose two-tier gating:
- soft gate: continuous telemetry + automated rollback suggestion when quality delta exceeds thresholds
- hard gate: block canary promotion if any critical test set has > X% degradation (we'll define X per workload)

anya: thinking about runtime API surface: add optional `precision_hint` header so clients can request quality-first or cost-first behavior. runtime should interpret: `precision_hint: quality` -> prefer higher-precision fallback; `precision_hint: cost` -> prefer lower-cost quant lane.

maria: small note on calibration: we must keep a separation between calibration dataset and eval dataset. calibration for numeric stability, eval for quality gating. store calibration artifacts with profile versioning.

liam: ops checklist additions:
- circuit-breaker on increased latency per-request > 200ms over baseline for 5m
- per-model rollback button in Console UI
- visibility: tokens-per-second and tail-latency by quant lane

nora: i'll set up a minimal dashboard template (latency, fallback_rate, quality_delta, cache_hit) and share link in a follow-up.

anya: action items:
- sam: draft QA gating thresholds + testset list (ETA Tue)
- maria: PR with config template + profile versioning + example calibration artifact location (ETA Wed)
- nora: dashboard + alerts (ETA Wed)
- liam: implement runtime flag + circuit-breaker hooks (ETA Thu)
- anya: I'll write the short checklist doc and tag owners in the RFC thread (ETA Fri)

sam: sounds good. one more: let's add a small A/B shadow run for 48h to collect real traffic signal before promoting. low overhead if we only snapshot 1% of inference outputs.

anya: agreed — we'll make shadow 1% by default, opt-in per-team in Console. i'll include that in the checklist. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — i'll open the PR after lunch and link here.

devops-bot: canary job started: shard us-east-2, model gptx-3b, quant_profile=fp8-lite, canary_pct=1%

anya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single-sentence checklist thread. if anything new comes up, drop it here or ping me directly.
